text:
hana: opened a tiny PR to add a short OptKit example combining micro-batching + KV prefetch + a quant-profile note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5107
owen: nice. can we include both Python and Go snippets and keep each under 12 lines for the sidebar?
rebecca: also please make the quant line advisory: recommend q3_k for short chats; note q2_x/q4_0 tradeoffs.
hana: added both snippets and changed wording to "recommended: q3_k for seq<64; q2_x/q4_0 for memory tradeoffs." kept snippets compact.
infra-bot: docs-lint: warning: code-fence-language-missing in docs/optkit/migrate.md: set fences to python/go
rebecca: also link to canonical API `/docs/sdk/reference/kv-prefetch` and add `(redirects from /legacy/kv)` to avoid 404s on older builds.
hana: updated link and fences; added a one-line CLI smoke command for local testing: `redwood-opt run --profile q3_k --batch 6 --kv-prefetch`
docs-bot: preview: success  https://deploy-preview-5107--docs.redwood.ai
owen: wording nit: change "use batching to save cost" -> "use micro-batching to reduce per-token cost while monitoring tail latency"
hana: updated phrasing and merged after CI green. will watch feedback for confusion around quant choices. thanks!"
